export_policy.previous: independent direct E2M3 and E2M1 files per selected checkpoint; NOT one truncatable source
export_policy.new: one high MX source with both BN banks per checkpoint; companion low derived from reloaded source; FP32 resume checkpoint separate

mx_rounding.previous: nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush, local subnormals supported
mx_rounding.new: high nearest ties-to-even; low code shift2; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush, local subnormals supported

mx_scale_policy.previous: same power-3 frexp rule on current G(W) for both modes; independent direct encoding; scales equal for same W
mx_scale_policy.new: high power-3 frexp rule on current G(W); same cached high codes/scales for both modes; low copies scales

purpose.previous: five complete train-only epochs: joint weight-only MX quantization without truncation
purpose.new: five complete train-only epochs: joint MX with low codes truncated from high source

source_cache.new: one detached high source per layer per paired minibatch; cleared before Adam

ste_policy.previous: identity through each MX quantizer; retain original G(W) derivatives
ste_policy.new: identity wrt G(W) for high and complete high-to-low truncation path; retain original G(W) derivatives
